Alert.purpose: An inline status message with an optional icon and action. Defaults to role=alert; use role=status for less urgent messages. Severity is announced in text as well as shown visually.

severity.description: Chooses the default icon, spoken severity label, and palette color.

color.description: Palette override; defaults to severity and does not change the icon or spoken label.

closeText.description: Accessible name of the default close button.

dismissible.description: Show the default close button when no action slot is supplied.

icon.description: Use false to hide the icon.

events: clay-close: a bubbling, cancelable CustomEvent<{ originalEvent: MouseEvent }> on the alert. The alert is hidden unless a listener calls preventDefault().

examples.title: Dismissible status message
examples.source: <Alert severity="info" variant="outlined" role="status" dismissible>Changes have been synced.</Alert>

content: icon: optional snippet replacing the severity icon, or false to hide it.
action: snippet replacing the close button.
events: onClose(event: MouseEvent): providing this callback shows the default close button unless action is set. The caller owns visibility; the callback does not hide the alert automatically.

examples.title: Dismissible status message
examples.source:
<script>
  let visible = $state(true);
</script>

{#if visible}
  <Alert severity="info" variant="outlined" role="status" onClose={() => (visible = false)}>Changes have been synced.</Alert>
{/if}

Chip.purpose: A compact label with optional avatar, icon, action and removal control. When clickable and removable, the label button and remove button are native siblings, never nested.

label.description: Visible label; also used to name the remove button.

clickable.description: Render the label as a button.

disabled.description: Disable both the label and remove buttons when present.

events: The body dispatches a native click when clickable. Listen on .clay-chip__body for label activation only.

clay-delete: a bubbling, cancelable CustomEvent<{ label: string, originalEvent: MouseEvent | KeyboardEvent }> dispatched on the chip by the remove button or by Backspace/Delete on either button. The chip is hidden unless a listener calls preventDefault().

examples.title: Removable chip
examples.source: <Chip label="Design systems" variant="outlined" color="secondary" deletable />

content: avatar and icon: optional leading snippets.
deleteIcon: snippet replacing the remove glyph.
events: onclick(event: MouseEvent): activates the label and implies a clickable native button even if clickable is omitted.

onDelete(event: MouseEvent | KeyboardEvent): providing this callback shows the remove button. Removal is requested by clicking it or pressing Backspace/Delete on either button. The caller owns visibility.

examples.title: Removable chip
examples.source:
<script>
  let visible = $state(true);
</script>

{#if visible}
  <Chip label="Design systems" variant="outlined" color="secondary" onDelete={() => (visible = false)} />
{/if}

ButtonGroup.purpose: A fieldset of related Buttons with shared variant, color and size styling. Give the group a name using aria-label, aria-labelledby or a legend; buttons retain native focus and activation.

disabled.description: Disables native buttons through the fieldset. Links are not form controls; pass disabled to linked Buttons separately.

fullWidth.description: Expand the group to its container width.

disableElevation.description: Remove the group's outer shadow while retaining inset shading on contained and outlined groups.

events: No component events; listen to native events on the buttons or fieldset.

examples.title: Outlined history controls
examples.source:
<ButtonGroup aria-label="Editor history" variant="outlined" color="secondary" size="small">
  <Button>Undo</Button>
  <Button>Redo</Button>
</ButtonGroup>

events: No component events; native handlers are forwarded to the fieldset.

IconButton.purpose: An accessible icon-only action or link. Supply an aria-label even when the icon is replaced by a loading indicator.

aria-label.description: Accessible name such as Search or Settings.

edge.description: Use a negative logical margin to align the specified edge.

loading.description: Replace the icon with a progress indicator, set aria-busy and disable activation.

inflated.description: Enable dome shading; render ClayLighting once in the document.

href.description: A nonempty URL renders an anchor. A disabled or loading anchor omits href and leaves the tab order.

target.description: Native link target; use with href.

rel.description: Native link relationship; use with href.

type.description: Native button type, ignored for a link.

content: loading-indicator: optional replacement for the accessible spinner; provide its accessible name.
events: Native click. Removing href prevents disabled link navigation but does not suppress custom DOM click listeners.

examples.title: Icon link
examples.source:
<IconButton aria-label="Search docs" href="/search">
  <svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" aria-hidden="true"><circle cx="10" cy="10" r="6" /><path d="m14 14 5 5" /></svg>
</IconButton>

content: loadingIndicator: optional snippet replacing the accessible spinner; provide its accessible name.
events: onclick(event: MouseEvent): native click, not invoked while disabled or loading.

List.purpose: A semantic list of ListItems. Name it with subheader (a visible heading that is also its accessible name) or aria-label. Dense spacing also reduces the height of ListItemButtons inside.

subheader.description: Visible heading above the items. Also the list's accessible name unless aria-label or aria-labelledby is set; it is not counted as an item.

dense.description: Use tighter gaps and compact action rows.

disablePadding.description: Remove the list's outer block padding.

events: No component events; native list attributes are forwarded.

examples.title: Navigation in a card
examples.source:
---
const folders = [
  { href: '/inbox', label: 'Inbox', icon: 'M22 12h-6l-2 3h-4l-2-3H2M5.5 5h13L22 12v7H2v-7z', current: true },
  { href: '/sent', label: 'Sent', icon: 'm22 2-7 20-4-9-9-4ZM22 2 11 13' },
  { href: '/starred', label: 'Starred', icon: 'm12 2 3.1 6.3 6.9 1-5 4.9 1.2 6.8-6.2-3.2-6.2 3.2 1.2-6.8-5-4.9 6.9-1z' },
];
---
<Card style="max-width: 320px; padding: 8px">
  <List aria-label="Mail folders" disablePadding>
    {folders.map((folder) => (
      <ListItem>
        <ListItemButton href={folder.href} selected={folder.current}>
          <ListItemIcon>
            <svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"><path d={folder.icon} /></svg>
          </ListItemIcon>
          <ListItemText primary={folder.label} />
        </ListItemButton>
      </ListItem>
    ))}
  </List>
</Card>

ListItem.purpose: A native li row. Put a ListItemButton inside for a clickable row (the row then drops its own padding automatically) and a separate trailing control in the secondary action, never inside the button.

disablePadding.description: Remove row padding. Not needed around a ListItemButton: rows whose direct child is one drop their padding automatically.

divider.description: Draw a divider below the row.

events: No component events; use native listeners.

<script>
  let drafts = $state([
    { href: '/drafts/quarterly-report', title: 'Quarterly report', edited: 'Edited 2 hours ago' },
    { href: '/drafts/launch-notes', title: 'Launch notes', edited: 'Edited yesterday' },
  ]);

<List aria-label="Drafts" style="max-width: 400px">
  {#each drafts as draft (draft.href)}
    <ListItem>
      <ListItemButton href={draft.href}>
        <ListItemText primary={draft.title} secondary={draft.edited} />
      </ListItemButton>
      {#snippet secondaryAction()}
        <IconButton size="small" aria-label={`Delete ${draft.title}`} onclick={() => (drafts = drafts.filter((d) => d !== draft))}>

ListItemButton.purpose: The full-width interactive part of a ListItem: an href makes it a link, otherwise it is a native button. Hover raises it out of the surface and selected presses it in, like a selected Tab. Keep any secondary control next to it, not inside.

selected.description: Style the current item and default aria-current to page for a link or true for a button.

disabled.description: Disable the button or omit href and remove a link from the tab order.

dense.description: Use compact row height even outside a dense List.

href.description: A nonempty URL renders a native anchor.

target.description: Native link target; use with href.

rel.description: Native link relationship; use with href.

type.description: Native button type, ignored for a link.

content: Default slot: non-interactive row content; use ListItemIcon and ListItemText for alignment.
events: Native click. Removing href prevents disabled link navigation but does not suppress custom DOM click listeners.

<script>

</script>

<Card style="max-width: 320px; padding: 8px">
  <List aria-label="Calendar view" disablePadding>
